## Summary

Locate the driver's side corner firewall port, pop out a small section of plastic, then use a Phillips head screwdriver. [t938]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Locate the firewall port on the driver's side corner for front-to-back cable runs.

_Procedure reported by [t938]._

## Tools

- Phillips head screwdriver [t938]

## Tips & gotchas

- Pop out a small section of plastic at the port and insert a Phillips bit to create space for prying wires through without puncturing anything. [t938]
